input.summary: Narrow mutual non-solicit to involved personnel for 12 months from the end of involvement, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs
input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the open-ended "for any reason" bar with a 12 months from the end of their involvement limit and added one sentence confining the restriction to employees directly involved in the Services, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches.

ops.oldText: during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason.
ops.newText: during the Term of this Agreement or for 12 months from the end of their involvement.

ops.text: The preceding sentence applies only to employees directly involved in the performance or receipt of the Services, and does not restrict general advertisements or other general solicitations not specifically directed at the other party's employees, or unsolicited approaches by an employee of the other party.
